verdict.rationale: YYLO can invoke an agent to summarize a repository (`yy pi --no-session 'Summarize this repository'`) and compare agent attempts with benchmark evidence, which are thin forms of AI-generated insight from the user's data. However there is no dedicated insights/suggestions surface, dashboard, or proactive recommendation feature — the product is primarily a task/workflow orchestrator for coding agents rather than an analytics or insight-generation layer. Missing for 10: a documented insights/suggestions UI or report feature, evidence of proactive AI-driven recommendations (not just on-demand summarization), and independent corroboration of this capability being used in practice.
